description: Re-inject essential project context immediately after context compaction (PostCompact hook, Claude Code 2.1.76+).

hooks.command: PROJECT_DIR="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$(pwd)}"; ESSENTIALS_FILE="$PROJECT_DIR/.claude/context-essentials.md"; if [ -f "$ESSENTIALS_FILE" ]; then BODY=$(head -150 "$ESSENTIALS_FILE"); jq -n --arg msg "PROJECT CONTEXT RE-INJECTED AFTER COMPACTION:\n\n$BODY" '{"systemMessage": $msg}'; else echo '{}'; fi; exit 0

usage: Copy this PostCompact hook to .claude/settings.json (or ~/.claude/settings.json for global usage). Maintain .claude/context-essentials.md with the architecture decisions, conventions, current tasks and critical constraints you want Claude to keep top-of-mind right after a compaction event. Pairs well with templates/hooks/pre-compact.json (which preserves context BEFORE compaction) and templates/hooks/context-reinject.json (SessionStart matcher 'compact' fallback for editors that don't fire PostCompact). Requires jq. Audit 2026-05-18 QW-20.
